title: RecipeDocumentFlattener keeps a hand switch for the layer op
body: undertow core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Building/RecipeDocumentFlattener.cs:39 (literal OpUnion=24..) and :151-155 (case 0..3) duplicate the layer-op to opcode mapping. It should read the kernel-generated Yeroket.GraphFramework.VM.SDFLayerOp / layer-op table (VIXEN already reads SdfLayerOpTable). Not touched in this lane (undertow is read-only here).

title: RmlUi panel documents collapse to 20 px when rows overflow (unstyled scrollbar)
body: editor.rcss declared no scrollbar size, so a panel document whose content outgrew it (body overflow:auto) gave the vertical scrollbar the whole width and laid the content out at 20 px (reproduced headless, test_panel_dock_documents). Fixed in editor.rcss by sizing scrollbarvertical; other RmlUi documents (HUD, dock chrome) that scroll need the same declaration or a shared rcss.

title: Recipe op catalogue has no argument for InvokeRecipe, so pack recipes cannot be added from data
body: SdfOpInfoTable lists InvokeRecipe (113) with argumentCount 0; the callee id is a runtime registry index in data[0] (SdfRecipeEvalDispatch.g.inc:674) and the editor registers only the open document, so a layer cannot reference a pack recipe by content id. Needs: a declared calleeRecipe argument kind (content id resolved at flatten) and the editor registering pack recipes into its RecipeRegistry (editoraudit gap 5).
